_comment: Ground truth for the error-card corpus, labelled by READING each response's
final text. This file is the oracle: it was derived by human inspection of
what the model actually said, not by any detection heuristic.
A run is an error only when the model refused/failed the request instead of
answering it. Short is not the signal -- batch_03/run03, run07, run13 and
run19 are 65-char legitimate permission replies, batch_04/run06 is a 294-char
search tool call, and most batch_04 responses are JSON tool payloads. All clean.
batch_04 added two errors, both arriving with NO prior answer (single frame),
which is the shape PayloadCollapseRule cannot see.
